pages.text: Techquity – Private markets, transformed Skip to content Sign in Toggle Navigation Products Customers Security News Careers Sign in Toggle Navigation Products Customers Security News Careers Sing in Home Johan Andersson 2026-09-18T10:28:41+00:00 Intelligent Infrastructure Powering Private Markets Offer your investors a superior investment experience with a secure platform trusted by leading financial institutions. Techquity’s platform streamlines workflows for fund marketing, contract negotiation, investor onboarding and financial reporting. Request a demo LP Does any existing LP have an MFN with a lower threshold than €25M? Techquity AIC Yes, two LPs in Fund III have MFN rights triggered at €15M and €20M respectively. Marketing Showcase your fund the way LPs deserve to see it. A polished, branded investor data room that signals competence and structure before the first capital call – turning routine touchpoints into details that build conviction. Onboarding of LPs Bring LPs in without the friction. Intelligent automation collapses subscription and KYC workflows from hours to minutes, so investors feel the quality of your operation from day one – and you reclaim the time it used to cost. Reporting Give LPs a clear view of their position whenever they want it. Real-time performance and capital activity in one place means investors stay informed without asking, and your team stops fielding the same questions by e-mail. 0 % LP satisfaction 0 min Average LP subscription time 0 % Fewer follow-up e-mails from LPs 0 bn Capital raised (€) 0 Live jurisdictions 0 % Less paperwork From First Close to Final Report Market new funds, negotiate contracts, onboard investors and manage investor relationships and financial reporting – all in a single secure environment. Techquity unifies every stage of the fund lifecycle with intelligent workflows designed for speed, accuracy and execution. View products Sorry, your browser doesn't support embedded videos. A Superior LP Experience With Techquity, private equity firms can offer their LPs a truly superior investment experience, from due diligence and contract negotiation to onboarding and financial reporting. Everything on one platform. Real-Time, Structured Data Watch every fundraising and transaction unfold live, as it happens. Track commitments, LP progress and much more in real-time with first-hand, high quality data. Clients can display data on the platform, export it or share via APIs. Next-Level Efficiency and Speed Manual coordination makes time and margins quietly disappear. Techquity replaces e-mail chains, spreadsheets and follow-ups with structured workflows powered by AI – freeing your team to focus on the work that compounds. Enterprise-Grade Security Security is increasingly a regulatory concern. Yet today, sensitive investor data still moves through e-mail. Techquity runs on secure, EU-hosted, fully audit-trailed infrastructure, where every action is logged and defensible. Trusted by Industry Leaders ”Techquity’s platform streamlined the process and saved us and our investors a lot of time by reducing administrative friction and providing an efficient digital investment experience. We recommend Techquity to any fund manager looking for a smooth and efficient fundraising solution.” Martin Fagerlund, Impilo “Techquity gives our investors a seamless and efficient investment experience, and reduces administrative work. This allows us to focus on investor relationships rather than operational overhead.” Erika Alm, Summa Equity “In the past, establishing a fund was frustratingly administrative and time-consuming. Techquity has completely transformed that – their platform allows us to focus on nurturing relationships with investors rather than tedious administration.” David von Wachenfeldt, Ballista Capital ”We honestly feel that the team and the service they provide are fantastic. Book demo Case: Impilo Johan Andersson 2026-02-04T15:39:56+00:00 Case: Impilo Impilo is a Nordic investment company with a sole focus on investments in companies operating in the pharmaceutical, medtech, specialist pharma services or other healthcare & related services industries. Their starting point is that their portfolio companies must contribute to positive and sustainable development of the societies and markets in which they operate in order to remain successful in the long term. ”Techquity’s platform streamlined the process and saved us and our investors a lot of time by reducing administrative friction and providing an efficient digital investment experience. We recommend Techquity to any fund manager looking for a smooth and efficient fundraising solution.” Martin Fagerlund, Impilo Case: Bertol Asset Management Johan Andersson 2026-02-04T15:40:25+00:00 Case: Bertol Asset Management Bertol Asset Management is an alternative investment manager based in Stockholm, backed by long-term capital from family offices, entrepreneurs and seasoned investors from the private equity community. ”We value clear communication with our investors. Techquity’s investor portal is an easy-to-use and intuitive platform that helps us share anything from confidential documents to general updates. Shared information is stored and available to investors at all times, reducing our admin while safeguarding against fraud. In addition to a great product we honestly feel that the team and the service they provide are fantastic. Always responsive, accommodating, agile as well as genuinely nice people. We really value the partnership approach that they have adopted.” Christian Magnuson, Bertol Asset Management Case: Course Corrected VC Johan Andersson 2026-02-04T15:40:51+00:00 Case: Course Corrected VC Together with the most visionary and passionate entrepreneurs, Course Corrected wants to be part of solving one of our planet’s most pressing challenges – battling climate change. Course Corrected is backing outstanding entrepreneurs and teams with fast growing and scalable businesses that drive the transformation towards climate positive alternatives, disrupting incumbents and with the potential to become leaders in their respective markets. Course Corrected is a stage agnostic fund with a primary focus on seed stages and Series A rounds, with potential to invest selectively in later stages in special opportunities. ”Techquity came recommended to us from another VC-fund as a streamlined service with a very easy-to-use data room solution. After the initial meetings with the team, we were very satisfied with the presented service as well as the on-hands service from the Techquity team. We looked at several options and felt that Techquity was most streamlined to our needs and offered a solution at an attractive price point for us. Techquity is very user-friendly and the investors that we have granted access to for our data room have all said it was very easy to get registered. We could use our name in the domain name and have our branding on the site. The team is very responsive and quick to provide solutions if any problems arise.” Sebastian Landström, Course Corrected VC Purpose-Built for Accelerated Fundraising and M&A Developed for private-equity professionals who need clarity, speed and control, Techquity unifies secure information exchange, investor onboarding and reporting into one streamlined experience.
